registers.sous: what links two mechanisms through a flow
registers.quoi: An interface point is where what leaves one mechanism enters another. It belongs to neither: described inside each of them, it gets entered twice, and the two copies eventually diverge.
registers.detecte: Orphan leaks — the ones no team feels responsible for. If one mechanism reports 90 leaving and the next reports 61 arriving, twenty-nine units vanish between them and nobody does the subtraction.
registers.filtre: This iteration changes what the neighbour receives: warn them, and measure on the slower of the two clocks.
registers.quand: From the third mechanism onward, once you have two contact points to compare.

registers.quoi: A resource does not circulate: it is consumed without coming back out, and it bounds what the others can do. Cross-cutting stocks belong here too — cash, context base, audience — because position decides, not dynamics.
registers.detecte: Contention. Two mechanisms with no flow between them slow down at the same time, and nobody makes the connection since there is no arrow to follow.
registers.filtre: Do not iterate to raise volume here: the resource is saturated and the gain will be absorbed by the queue.
registers.quand: From the second mechanism onward. The most useful register, and the most invisible otherwise.

registers.quoi: An event does not repeat, so it cannot be steered. It is not modelled: it is logged. Anything that returns every year — seasonality, holidays — is not one: it is an unmodelled input.
registers.detecte: Nothing, and that is deliberate. It produces no friction, it produces an invalidation: measurements taken before are no longer comparable to those taken after.
registers.filtre: Do not compare across this date.
registers.quand: As you go, starting now. A line takes thirty seconds and saves a conclusion.

registers.sous: who holds authority over which lever
registers.quoi: Authority cuts across mechanisms: one person often holds levers in three of them. Duplicated inside each sheet, that concentration stays invisible.
registers.detecte: The real human constraint. It is usually the attention of two or three people, rather than budget or time, that bounds the whole.
registers.filtre: This iteration has no available owner, whatever its priority.
registers.quand: As you go. The « can hold a refusal » column is the most discriminating one.
